newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold, silver close lower on easy world trend.
newsitem.headline: India gold, silver close lower on easy world trend.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed 15 rupees lower at 4,625 rupees per 10 grammes as a downtrend in world markets triggered fresh selling.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) closed 200 rupees lower at 54,100 rupees per piece.
** Silver (.999) closed 15 rupees lower at 6,725 rupees per kg but up 25 rupees from the opening 6,700 rupees as a shortage of ready stock helped prices recover after an easy start.
Gold 24 carat closed 15 rupees lower at 4,625 rupees per 10 grammes on fresh selling, triggered by a downtrend in world markets on Thursday, dealers said.
Arrivals of smuggled gold dropped in the current week but continuing sluggish market conditions dampened sentiment.
Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) closed 200 rupees lower at 54,100 rupees per piece.
Silver (.999) closed 15 rupees lower at 6,725 rupees per kg but was up 25 rupees from the opening 6,700 rupees.
"Silver prices remained weak in early trade following a drop in world markets but recovered on a shortage of ready stock," said a broker. Silver was up 15 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
